metrics.description: This metric shows the number of connections to the database. Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template: CONNECTIONS = data("DatabaseConnections", filter=filter("namespace", "AWS/RDS") and filter("stat", "mean") and filter("DBInstanceIdentifier", "*"){{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="last_value", maxExtrapolations=2).mean(by=["DBInstanceIdentifier"])

metrics.description: This metric shows the percentage of CPU utilization. Under 20% green, over 80% red.

job.template: RDS_CPU_UTILIZATION = data("CPUUtilization", filter=filter("namespace", "AWS/RDS") and filter("stat", "mean") and filter("DBInstanceIdentifier", "*"){{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="last_value", maxExtrapolations=2).mean(by=["DBInstanceIdentifier"])

metrics.description: This metric shows the number of outstanding I/Os (read/write requests) waiting to access the disk. Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template: DiskQueueDepth = data("DiskQueueDepth", filter=filter("namespace", "AWS/RDS") and filter("stat", "mean") and filter("DBInstanceIdentifier", "*"){{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="last_value", maxExtrapolations=2).mean(by=["DBInstanceIdentifier"])

metrics.description: This metric shows the amount of available RAM in bytes. Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template: FREEABLE_MEMORY = data("FreeableMemory", filter=filter("namespace", "AWS/RDS") and filter("stat", "mean") and filter("DBInstanceIdentifier", "*"){{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="last_value", maxExtrapolations=2).mean(by=["DBInstanceIdentifier"])

metrics.description: This metric shows the amount of available storage space in bytes. Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template: FREESTORAGESPACE = data("FreeStorageSpace", filter=filter("namespace", "AWS/RDS") and filter("stat", "mean") and filter("DBInstanceIdentifier", "*"){{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="last_value", maxExtrapolations=2).mean(by=["DBInstanceIdentifier"])

metrics.description: This metric shows the incoming network traffic on the DB instance, including both customer database traffic and Amazon RDS traffic in bytes/second. Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template: NETWORK_RECEIVE_THROUGHPUT = data("NetworkReceiveThroughput", filter=filter("namespace", "AWS/RDS") and filter("stat", "mean") and filter("DBInstanceIdentifier", "*"){{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="last_value", maxExtrapolations=2).mean(by=["DBInstanceIdentifier"])

metrics.description: This metric shows the outgoing network traffic on the DB instance, including both customer database traffic and Amazon RDS traffic in bytes/second. Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template: NETWORK_TRANSMIT_THROUGHPUT = data("NetworkTransmitThroughput", filter=filter("namespace", "AWS/RDS") and filter("stat", "mean") and filter("DBInstanceIdentifier", "*"){{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="last_value", maxExtrapolations=2).mean(by=["DBInstanceIdentifier"])

metrics.description: This metric shows the average number of disk read I/O operations per second. Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template: ReadIOPS = data("ReadIOPS", filter=filter("namespace", "AWS/RDS") and filter("stat", "mean") and filter("DBInstanceIdentifier", "*"){{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="last_value", maxExtrapolations=2).mean(by=["DBInstanceIdentifier"])

metrics.description: This metric shows the average amount of time taken per disk I/O operation in milliseconds. Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template: ReadLatency = data("ReadLatency", filter=filter("namespace", "AWS/RDS") and filter("stat", "mean") and filter("DBInstanceIdentifier", "*"){{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="last_value", maxExtrapolations=2).scale(1000).mean(by=["DBInstanceIdentifier"])

metrics.description: This metric shows the average number of bytes read from disk per second. Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template: ReadThroughput = data("ReadThroughput", filter=filter("namespace", "AWS/RDS") and filter("stat", "mean") and filter("DBInstanceIdentifier", "*"){{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="last_value", maxExtrapolations=2).mean(by=["DBInstanceIdentifier"])

metrics.description: This metric shows the amount of time a read replica DB instance lags behind the source DB instance in seconds. Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template: REPLICATION_LAG = data("ReplicaLag", filter=filter("namespace", "AWS/RDS") and filter("stat", "mean") and filter("DBInstanceIdentifier", "*"){{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="last_value", maxExtrapolations=2).mean(by=["DBInstanceIdentifier"])

metrics.description: This metric shows the amount of swap space used on the DB instance in bytes. Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template: SWAP_USAGE = data("SwapUsage", filter=filter("namespace", "AWS/RDS") and filter("stat", "mean") and filter("DBInstanceIdentifier", "*"){{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="last_value", maxExtrapolations=2).mean(by=["DBInstanceIdentifier"])

metrics.description: This metric shows the average number of disk write I/O operations per second. Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template: WriteIOPS = data("WriteIOPS", filter=filter("namespace", "AWS/RDS") and filter("stat", "mean") and filter("DBInstanceIdentifier", "*"){{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="last_value", maxExtrapolations=2).mean(by=["DBInstanceIdentifier"])

metrics.description: This metric shows the average amount of time taken to write per disk I/O operation in milliseconds. Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template: WriteLatency = data("WriteLatency", filter=filter("namespace", "AWS/RDS") and filter("stat", "mean") and filter("DBInstanceIdentifier", "*"){{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="last_value", maxExtrapolations=2).scale(1000).mean(by=["DBInstanceIdentifier"])

metrics.description: This metric shows the average number of bytes written to disk per second. Darker colors indicate higher relative values.

job.template: WriteThroughput = data("WriteThroughput", filter=filter("namespace", "AWS/RDS") and filter("stat", "mean") and filter("DBInstanceIdentifier", "*"){{#filter}} and {{{filter}}}{{/filter}}, extrapolation="last_value", maxExtrapolations=2).mean(by=["DBInstanceIdentifier"])

uiModel.o11ySignalflowTemplate: A = data('DatabaseConnections', filter=filter('namespace', 'AWS/RDS') and filter('stat', 'mean') and filter('DBInstanceIdentifier', '*'), extrapolation='last_value', maxExtrapolations=2).mean(by=['DBInstanceIdentifier']).count().publish(label='A')
